title: Complete requirements-specification on O10
description: The assigned Participant reports the requirements-specification work as done for the O10 SEU.
annotation: A Deliverable moves forward only when its Work Item is reported done. The SEU records the outcome.

title: Complete architecture-decision-record on O10
description: The assigned Participant reports the architecture-decision-record work as done for the O10 SEU.
annotation: Each Deliverable has its own Work Item, so progress is tracked per Deliverable and not for the SEU as a whole.

title: Complete detailed-design-specification on O10
description: The assigned Participant reports the detailed-design-specification work as done for the O10 SEU.
annotation: With the block released, the Deliverable completes as normal. Nothing was skipped to get here.

title: Test environment is unavailable
description: The Participant cannot continue because the test environment is down.

title: Lending service API is not ready for integration
description: Integration testing cannot start until the lending service API is available.
annotation: An external dependency that is not ready is raised as a blocker, not left in a conversation.

title: App store review rejects the build
description: The store review rejected the submitted build.
annotation: A failed outcome raises an Attention Item just as a blocked one does.

title: Design approval is pending
description: Design work waits on an approval that has not been given.
annotation: A Work Item reported as blocked raises an Attention Item. The block stays visible until someone resolves it.

title: Release the open blocker on O10
description: Work the oldest open Attention Item on the O10 SEU through Acknowledged, In Progress and Resolved.
annotation: Resolving the Attention Item releases the Work Item, and dispatch continues from where it stopped.

title: Release the open blocker on O12
description: Work the oldest open Attention Item on the O12 SEU through Acknowledged, In Progress and Resolved.

title: Release the open blocker on O19
description: Work the oldest open Attention Item on the O19 SEU through Acknowledged, In Progress and Resolved.
annotation: Releasing the blocker records who resolved it and when.

title: Release the open blocker on O21
description: Work the oldest open Attention Item on the O21 SEU through Acknowledged, In Progress and Resolved.
annotation: The release record is kept with the SEU, so the history of the submission stays traceable.

title: Lead reviewer unavailable for the next two weeks
description: Review capacity drops for two weeks.

title: Push provider changes its API terms
description: The provider announces new API terms that affect push delivery.

title: Library board requests a scope change
description: The board asks for a change to the agreed scope.

title: Critical vulnerability in a dependency
description: A review of the source code finds a critical vulnerability in a dependency.
annotation: A review records a Finding against a Deliverable. The Finding carries a severity.

title: Convert the Finding to an Obligation
description: Convert the open dependency Finding into an Obligation.
annotation: Converting a Finding creates an Obligation, so the issue stays tracked until its Evidence is in.

title: Waive the dependency Finding
description: Waive the open dependency Finding.

title: Create the API Standards Pack
description: Declare a Technology Pack that carries ArchVault's API design checklist, so every API Deliverable can be reviewed against the same standard.
annotation: Packs are the extension mechanism through which behaviors are introduced. This one adds an API review checklist and an Obligation.

pack.name: ArchVault API Standards
pack.description: API design and versioning standards for ArchVault services.

checklists.name: API Design Review
checklists.description: Review of an API contract before it is released.

items.statement: Every endpoint is described in the published API contract.
Breaking changes are introduced only in a new major version.
Error responses use the shared error format.
Every endpoint states the authority needed to call it.

obligationDefinitions.title: The API contract is reviewed before each release
obligationDefinitions.description: Each release confirms that the API contract matches the implemented endpoints.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: The contract review is recorded and every difference is resolved.

requiredEvidence.title: API contract review record
requiredEvidence.description: Record of the contract review for the release.

title: Accept the code for ArchVault API Standards
description: Accept "technology-archvault-api-standards" in the Ontology so the Pack can be activated.
annotation: A new Pack code is a proposal until the Ontology accepts it. Acceptance activates the Pack.

title: Create the Accessibility Pack
description: Declare a Compliance Pack that makes accessibility review an Obligation with required Evidence.
annotation: A Compliance Pack turns a requirement into an Obligation with required Evidence, so conformance is checked each release.

pack.name: ArchVault Accessibility
pack.description: Accessibility requirements for the ArchVault reader applications.

checklists.name: Accessibility Verification
checklists.description: Verification of the reader applications against the accessibility requirements.

items.statement: Every screen has labels that a screen reader announces.
Images that carry meaning have a text alternative.
Text meets the minimum contrast ratio.
Text can be enlarged without losing content.

obligationDefinitions.title: Accessibility conformance is reviewed each release
obligationDefinitions.description: Each release confirms conformance with the accessibility requirements.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: The review is recorded and no open defect blocks a core task.

requiredEvidence.title: Accessibility review record
requiredEvidence.description: Record of the accessibility review for the release.

title: Accept the code for ArchVault Accessibility
description: Accept "compliance-archvault-accessibility" in the Ontology so the Pack can be activated.
annotation: The Ontology decides which codes are canonical, so the vocabulary stays consistent across Packs.

title: Create the Release Governance Pack
description: Declare an Organisation Pack that sets how ArchVault approves a release.
annotation: An Organisation Pack carries how the organisation works, such as when a release may be approved.

pack.name: ArchVault Release Governance
pack.description: How ArchVault approves and records a release.

checklists.name: Release Readiness
checklists.description: Checks made before a release is approved.

items.statement: The release owner has recorded approval.

obligationDefinitions.title: Release approval is recorded
obligationDefinitions.description: Each release records who approved it and when.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: The approval is recorded against the release.

requiredEvidence.title: Release approval record
requiredEvidence.description: Record of the approval for the release.

title: Accept the code for ArchVault Release Governance
description: Accept "organisation-archvault-release-governance" in the Ontology so the Pack can be activated.
annotation: Once accepted, the Pack is Active and can be selected by a Profile.
